title: Equivariant quantum-K Toda presentation for a type-A partial flag variety
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author transports quantum determinant relations through partial-flag forgetting maps and proves the required pushforward identities using Grassmann-bundle geometry and the quantum corrections. The formal complete-Nakayama step is not treated as the whole proof; the nonclassical relations and their geometric construction are kept as core.
author: Kamyar Amini; Irit Huq-Kuruvilla; Leonardo C. Mihalcea; Daniel Orr; Weihong Xu
